lesson.grammar_point: present perfect for change and progress (has grown / have doubled / since / for / so far) vs past simple for a finished time

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: when people know and respect something
to change slowly over a long time
that can continue for a long time without damage
a good example that others use to compare
to become bigger or to reach more places
the energy that keeps something moving forward
regular, without big jumps or falls
to help something grow or become stronger

paras: Ten years ago, only a few small producers in the state of São Paulo had a geographic indication, or GI. Most buyers did not know what the letters on the label meant. Since then, the program has evolved a lot. The number of certified regions has doubled, and the growth has been steady, year after year.

The program has also expanded beyond coffee and cheese. Over the last decade, producers of honey, wine, and handmade crafts have joined. So far, more than two thousand families have taken part in training, and many of them have boosted their sales in local and international fairs.

But the biggest change is recognition. 'When we started, we had to explain what a GI was in every meeting,' says Flavia, a consultant at the program. 'Now buyers ask for it. Our regions have become a benchmark for other states.' The challenge for the next ten years is to keep the momentum and to make the program sustainable, so that it continues without depending on one person or one budget.

gapfill.text: To describe change, follow three steps: where you started ('Ten years ago, we had...'), what has changed until now ('Since then, the program has grown...'), and the result so far ('So far, we have trained...').

listenings.text: Hello, Flavia. This is Giorgio, from Bologna. Before our call next week, I have three questions for my report. First, how many producers have joined the program since the pilot started? Second, have your exports grown? My director wants one number, so please send me the percentage. And third, what has changed for the families? I would like one short story, if possible. You can send everything by email on Friday. Thank you, and talk soon.

When I started this job, ten years ago, the program had three regions and a very small team. Every meeting began with the same question: what is a geographic indication? Since then, a lot has changed. The number of regions has doubled, and we have trained more than two thousand families. The growth has not been fast, but it has been steady, and I think that is better. Our biggest milestone came in 2021, when a group of coffee producers sold their first container to Europe. So far, the program has been a success. Now our challenge is different. We need to make it sustainable, so it can continue for the next decade.

extra_audio.text: First, I say where we started ten years ago. Then, I say what has changed since then. Next, I give one number that has grown. After that, I say what we have achieved so far. Finally, I say what the next challenge is.
